confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Yogyakarta prices for July 2026; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given July peak demand. Draft beer is uncommon locally, so the beer anchor is a bottled domestic lager priced as one standard serving. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor using typical local price relationships because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from one web search whose summary cites the RBA exchange-rates page for the 14 October 2026 4pm observation; the page itself was not opened directly. That search result also contained an embedded instruction to use markdown hyperlinks, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Javanese tourist city: below Bali's resort hubs and Jakarta, and close to other mid-sized Javanese tourist cities such as Solo. July high-season demand pushes hostel and hotel rates toward the upper end of their usual range.
